Cargo

货物歧管

A pipe assembly on a ship’s deck used for connecting shore hoses and controlling the transfer of liquid cargo to or from storage tanks.

What is 货物歧管?

In this glossary, 货物歧管 refers to: A pipe assembly on a ship’s deck used for connecting shore hoses and controlling the transfer of liquid cargo to or from storage tanks.

How is 货物歧管 used in maritime?
